miraheze-sitenotice-closed-locked: Wiki-gan waa la xiray sababtoo ah [[m:Special:MyLanguage/Stewards|Wakiilada]] ama [[m:Special:MyLanguage/Trust and Safety|Trust and Safety]] ayaa go'aamiyey inuu ku xadgudbayo [[m:Content Policy|Siyaasadda Mawduuca]] ee Miraheze ama siyaasadaha kale ee caalamiga ah. Maamulayaasha waa inay heleen iimayl ama farriin bogga wada hadalka ah oo ay ku jiraan macluumaad dheeraad ah, oo ay ku jirto sida rafcaan looga qaadan karo.
miraheze-sitenotice-closed-private: Wiki-gan si otomaatig ah ayaa loo xiray sababtoo ah '''wax tafatir ah''' ama '''falal diiwaan''' ah laguma samayn 120-kii maalmood ee la soo dhaafay. Maadaama wiki-gani yahay mid gaar ah, isticmaale kasta dib uma furi karo isagoo adeegsanaya habka caadiga ah ee codsiga dib-u-furista. Haddii wiki-gan aan dib loo furin 6 bilood gudahood, waa la tirtiri karaa. Fiiro gaar ah: Haddii aad tahay maamule ku jira wiki-gan, waxaad aadi kartaa [[Special:ManageWiki]] oo aad ka saari kartaa calaamadda sanduuqa "Closed" si aad dib ugu furto.
miraheze-sitenotice-closed: Wiki-gan otomaatig toos ah ayaa loo [[m:Special:MyLanguage/Dormancy Policy|xiray]] sababtoo ah '''wax tafatir ah''' ama '''falal diiwaan''' ah laguma samayn 120-kii maalmood ee la soo dhaafay. Haddii aad tahay isticmaale (oo aan ahayn maamulaha) doonaya in wiki-gan dib loo furo, fadlan ka codso [[m:Requests for reopening wikis|Codsiyada dib-u-furista wiki-yada]]. Fiiro gaar ah: Haddii aad tahay maamule ku jira wiki-gan, waxaad aadi kartaa [[Special:ManageWiki]] oo aad ka saari kartaa calaamadda sanduuqa "Closed" si aad dib ugu furto.
miraheze-sitenotice-inactive-private: Wiki-gan '''wax tafatir ah''' ama '''falal diiwaan''' ah laguma samayn 60-kii maalmood ee la soo dhaafay, waxaana si toos ah loogu calaamadeeyey inuu yahay '''aan firfircoonayn'''. Wiki-gan (maadaama uu yahay mid gaar ah) uma qalmo in isticmaale kale dib loogu furo codsi ahaan, sida caadiga ah wiki-yada dadweynaha. Haddii wiki-gan uu weli aan firfircoonayn 135 maalmood laga bilaabo hadda, wuxuu u qalmi doonaa '''in la tirtiro'''. Fiiro gaar ah: Haddii aad tahay maamule, waxaad aadi kartaa [[Special:ManageWiki]] oo aad adigu ka saari kartaa calaamadda "inactive".

miraheze-warnmessage: [https ://meta.miraheze.org/wiki/Stewards%27_noticeboard '''Shaqaalaha Miraheze'''] waxay ogaadeen in wiki-gan [[Special:RecentChanges|'''wax tafatir ah''']] ama [[Special:Logs|'''diiwaanno''']] lagu samayn 45-kii maalmood ee la soo dhaafay. Haddii aad doonayso inaad ka hortagto in wiki-gan '''la xiro''', fadlan halkan ka bilow inaad muujiso calaamado dhaqdhaqaaq. Haddii aan wax calaamado ah oo muujinaya in wiki-gan la isticmaalayo la helin 15-ka maalmood ee soo socda, wiki-gan waa la xiri karaa iyadoo la raacayo [https://meta.miraheze.org/wiki/Dormancy_Policy '''Siyaasadda Hurdada''']. Wiki-gan wuxuu markaas u qalmi doonaa in isticmaale kale uu la wareego. Haddii uusan cidina la wareegin oo uu weli aan firfircoonayn 135 maalmood laga bilaabo hadda, wiki-gan wuxuu u qalmi doonaa '''in la tirtiro'''. Fadlan hubi inaad barato [https://meta.miraheze.org/wiki/Dormancy_Policy Siyaasadda Hurdada] ee Miraheze. Haddii wiki-gan uu leeyahay dhaqdhaqaaq, waxaad aadi kartaa [[MediaWiki:Sitenotice]] oo aad adigu ka saari kartaa ogeysiiskan. Haddii aad qabto su'aalo ama walaacyo kale, fadlan ha ka waaban inaad [https://meta.miraheze.org/wiki/Stewards%27_noticeboard '''Nala soo xiriirto'''].

requestcustomdomain-text:
Waad ku mahadsan tahay doorashada Miraheze!

Kahor intaadan bilaabin, hubi inaad akhrido [[Custom domains|Domain-yada gaarka ah]]. Domain-kaagu waa inuu si sax ah u tilmaamaa ka hor intaadan samayn codsi domain gaar ah. Ogow inaad codsan karto domain gaar ah oo keliya marka codsiga wiki-gaaga la ansixiyo oo wiki-ga la abuuro.

Xaaladaha badankood, haddii domain-kaaga si sax ah loo habeeyey oo aad tahay maamule wiki, domain-kaaga gaarka ah waa in lagu habeeyaa hal daqiiqo ama ka yar. Haddii uu khalad dhaco, ama aad doonayso inaad codsato jiheyn, fadlan ka samee hawl [[Phorge]].
requestimport-text:
Ku soo dhawoow RequestImport! Si aad u bilowdo soo dejintaada, fadlan buuxi foomkan si aan u eegno codsigaaga. Codsiga wiki-gaaga waxaa dib u eegi doona xubin ka tirsan kooxda Teknoolojiyadda ama Wakiil, waxaana lagala socon karaa bogga lagu siin doono markaad gudbiso codsigaaga.

Haddii soo gelintaada halkan ay waqtigeedu dhammaado ama ay fashilanto, fadlan ka samee hawl [[Phorge]].

Haddii aad sidoo kale doonayso inaad soo dejiso sawirrada, fadlan sidoo kale ka samee hawl [[Phorge]].
